Exhibit 99.21

 

Notice to ASX and LSE

 

Rio Tinto board update

 

20 April 2018

 

Following the announcement by Rio Tinto on 15 February 2018, of the appointment of Moya Greene as an independent non-executive director, the company confirms that Ms Greene will join the board with effect from 17 September 2018.
